findings.claim: Journey steps are truncated, and some honest gaps from the source are lost. I compared each step with its numbered item in the source 'Narrativa ponta-a-ponta' section: 45 of 294 steps keep less than 90% of the source text, spread across 26 JNY (001, 002, 003, 004, 005, 007, 008, 010, 011, 012, 013, 014, 015, 016, 017, 019, 020, 021, 022, 023, 026, 030, 031, 032, 033, 039). Concrete cases: (1) JNY-001 step 1 ends on the bare heading 'Nota de conformidade (não resolvida).' and drops the unresolved CFM 1.636/2002 art. 3º point about impartial clinic distribution. (2) JNY-001 step 4 drops the 2-business-day deadline for the psychological result and the reduced-validity rule (art. 9º §§2º-3º). (3) JNY-003:30 ends on the heading 'Base legal (com ressalva de vigência).' and drops the Portaria 968/2022 vs 495/2025 vigência caveat and the note that no federal norm requires the approver. (4) JNY-032:26 stops mid-quote at '"Multa cancelada.' and drops the restitution path. (5) JNY-008 step 3 drops 'não existe, em nenhuma fonte lida, um requisito de captura completa antes da remoção'. JNY-008 step 6 (line 31) drops 'sem critério normativo de precedência encontrado nas fontes lidas', which is the gap OD-R19-004 records. The pattern looks like a sentence splitter cutting at bold labels and at periods inside quotes. This breaks contract §3 ('todos os passos da seção Narrativa') and the escalation prompt's explicit rule 'um passo não pode ser só cabeçalho nem texto truncado'. The TASK-0008 report still states PASS.
findings.fix: Architect: re-transcribe every Narrativa item of the 40 JRN in full, or as a faithful distillation that keeps every material condition, deadline, legal caveat and declared gap. Include sub-bullets and bold-labelled notes, and do not split at periods inside quotes or abbreviations. Rerun a local audit that compares each step with its source item: no step below the source content, and no step ending on a heading or open quote. Record the per-JNY result in the TASK-0008 report, then rerun `devai check --only journeys` and format.

findings.claim: The new rule (c)/(d) tests cover only the missing and orphan cases: term without GE, GE without term, JRN without JNY, JNY without JRN, UC without bundle entry, and bundle entry without UC. C-02-04 and §5 also require rejecting several other cases, and none of them has a test: case-insensitive duplicate GE term; GE status other than draft; missing GE provenance; unresolved related_invariants; swapped JNY↔JRN ID; divergent JNY title; divergent UC title; UC in the wrong bundle; duplicate bundle case ID; actor missing from roles or empty actors; incomplete JNY content (no steps, no AC, no persona, non-draft); totals other than 40 or 110. verify.mjs implements branches for these (GLOSSARY_TERM_DUPLICATE, GLOSSARY_STATUS_INVALID, GLOSSARY_PROVENANCE_MISSING, GLOSSARY_INVARIANT_UNRESOLVED, JOURNEY_DIVERGENT, JOURNEY_CONTENT_INCOMPLETE, BUNDLE_ID_DUPLICATE, USE_CASE_DIVERGENT, USE_CASE_ROLE_UNDECLARED, *_COUNT_DIVERGENT), but no test exercises them, so removing any of these branches would leave the suite green.
findings.fix: Inspector: add one negative test per §5 violation, each asserting the specific violation code and the path/ID. Show RED against a verify.mjs with that branch removed (disposable copy or recorded mutation), then GREEN on the current gate. Do not edit the existing tests. Engineer changes the gate only if a new test exposes a gap.

findings.claim: Rule (c) checks only that provenance is a non-empty array. It does not check that provenance is `docs/framework/glossary/domain.md:<n>` with line n holding the entry's term, and it does not check that the GE file name matches the entry's `id`. Journey titles are compared case-insensitively (canonicalText), while UC titles are compared exactly.
findings.fix: Validate the GE provenance format and the term on the cited line, and check that basename equals id. Pick one title-comparison policy (exact, as for UC) for both JNY and UC.
